purpose: Preview only; not integrated into game
common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:10 landscape game dialogue UI design review sheet for the Chinese parallel-world puzzle game 《世界不按说明书》. This is a preview proposal, not a final game screenshot. Input references: image 1 user reference is STYLE ONLY for ivory cut-corner wide dialogue card, compact name label, clear text and tiny continue glyph; image 2 is Yanyue character IDENTITY only (sprite atlas, reconstruct an intact upper-body portrait, NEVER show disconnected limbs); image 3 is Tesla character IDENTITY only; image 4 is GAME VISUAL CONTEXT ONLY, warm ivory floor, isometric rail puzzle, brass trim. Preserve faces, hair and clothing. Yanyue: young adult woman brown twin buns, blue crystal hairpins and earrings, white high-neck knit top, dark pleated skirt. Tesla: adult slim dark swept-back hair, small mustache, black Victorian three-piece suit and pocket-watch chain. Never include the other character in this single-character sheet.
Art direction: ivory paper + muted brass + deep ink navy, restrained cyan/lilac offsets suggest overlapping parallel worlds. Distinctive CUT-CORNER asymmetric paper/optical-glass UI, not generic rounded app card, not ornate fantasy filigree, not neon cyberpunk, no huge gear ornaments. Stable opaque-enough text backing; no texture or bright star crosses behind glyphs. Technical illustration precision with warm illustrative portraits consistent with references. Chinese exact clean readable typesetting, no gibberish or invented labels. Demonstrate visual font treatment clearly, real Chinese text. Wide tracking only on names, never spaced-out body copy. Do not claim a specific existing font; show design intent. No handwriting body, no glitch effects on actual text. Sheet background warm off-white. Small editorial sheet heading, main component at large readable scale in middle, small lower gameplay placement inset with faithful isometric rail layout (do not invent other gameplay UI), and a clean font specimen footer. No busy decorations.

designs.title: 衍月 A｜星月折页
designs.prompt: Only Yanyue, full intact waist-up illustrated portrait extending above LEFT edge of a WIDE low dialogue panel, always LEFT of text. Main narrative dialogue style, asymmetrical warm ivory folded-paper polygon with tiny crescent notch and pale cyan blue crystal edge, muted brass thin constellation line, small semitransparent double-sheet offset only 5px behind border. No portrait obscuring text. Header exact “衍月 A｜星月折页”, small category “大厅 · 重要剧情”. Nameplate “衍月”. Dialogue exact “压住纸的那个镇纸？” underneath a second line “原来，要压稳的是世界。” Body in refined open Chinese Song/serif with slightly calligraphic but highly legible strokes, ink navy; name elegant heavier wedge-serif, pale ice-blue crescent mark. Continue small crystal diamond near far lower right. Footer title “字形设计” specimen “衍月” in display style then “先看清规则，再让世界配合。” in body style then “姓名 30 px · 正文 26 px · 行距 1.45”. Inset shows full narrative component on lower part of lobby-like isometric background, foreground upper body at left; lower panel around 22% screen height, middle unobstructed. Design feels warm, observant and magical but precise.

designs.title: 特斯拉 A｜黄铜档案
designs.prompt: Only Tesla, intact waist-up illustrated portrait extending above RIGHT end of a WIDE low dialogue panel, always RIGHT of text. Text stays left-aligned and leaves a safe gutter for portrait on right. Main narrative dialogue style, asymmetrical ivory archival-paper polygon with clipped corner, slim muted brass border, tiny partial astronomical ruler and small ink-navy archival tab, subtle double-sheet behind edge. Header exact “特斯拉 A｜黄铜档案”, category “大厅 · 任务交代”. Nameplate “特斯拉”. Dialogue exact two lines “我们用镇纸锚定世界。” and “先定星位，再压月痕，最后封界缝。” Body in restrained square Chinese Song/serif, orderly technical book typesetting, darker ink navy. Name firm heavier squared serif, small brass coordinate mark. Tiny continue glyph at far lower LEFT so not covered by portrait. Footer “字形设计”, specimen “特斯拉” in name style then “位置确认，开始校准。” in body style then “姓名 30 px · 正文 26 px · 行距 1.45”. Gameplay placement inset shows large lower dialogue bar 22% height with Tesla RIGHT, no portrait covering center puzzle. Authoritative calm, brass observatory archival aesthetic.

designs.title: 衍月 B｜界缝薄片
designs.prompt: Only Yanyue, SMALL shoulder-up portrait on LEFT edge of a compact floating horizontal optical-glass note, text on right of portrait. This is gameplay light-dialogue, much smaller in lower inset than narrative component, no giant bust and no huge bar. Panel like two subtly misregistered clipped translucent sheets, white frosted text area plus narrow cyan-lilac edge and tiny crescent, little brass tab, just one quiet overlap seam. Header exact “衍月 B｜界缝薄片”, category “关内 · 观察与回应”. Name “衍月”. Exact dialogue “位置对了，重量还不够。” Single readable line or at most two short lines. Body warm, humanist Chinese sans/gothic with very slightly softened endpoints, dark ink navy, name refined tiny-serif for personality. Footer “字形设计”, specimen “衍月” and body sample “让它留在这里，换一套规则。” then “姓名 22 px · 正文 23 px · 行距 1.35”. Small gameplay inset: corner panel is in lower-left safe margin BELOW central rail but avoiding existing left-side task panel; width around 32% game view, height 10%, game puzzle center fully visible. Show leader labels outside inset only if needed, avoid overlaid technical clutter. No click-to-continue prompt because this is nonblocking timed dialogue.

designs.title: 特斯拉 B｜观测通讯
designs.prompt: Only Tesla, SMALL shoulder-up portrait at RIGHT end of a compact light-radio-communication card, always RIGHT of left-aligned text. Gameplay remote guidance, ivory frosted rectangular shape with clipped corners, narrow brass calibration ticks along top edge, one small stylized signal mark, restrained ink-blue underline, subtle optical double border. No big holographic screens or actual dense soundwaves. Header exact “特斯拉 B｜观测通讯”, category “关内 · 首次规则教学”. Name “特斯拉”. Exact dialogue “切到重力世界，让镇纸压下踏板。” Tiny separate keycap “2” and label “重力世界” under dialogue, not embedded into paragraph. Body precise medium Chinese sans/gothic with clean open counters, dark navy. Name squared heavier serif. Footer “字形设计”, specimen “特斯拉” and body sample “切换世界，位置仍然保留。” then “姓名 22 px · 正文 23 px · 行距 1.35”. Gameplay inset: card in lower-right safe blank area, width around 35% screen, height 11%, Tesla right; must not cover central rail, tall moon receiver, exit or existing HUD. This is nonblocking guidance, no continue arrow or blocking screen dimming.

designs.title: 衍月 C｜月牙便笺
designs.prompt: Only Yanyue, tiny clean face/neck portrait at LEFT end of a very small clipped-paper dialogue sliver, text to its right. Short reaction style, not same as long narrative or medium communication. A small moon-tab holding an ivory folded note, thin crescent accent in cyan, restrained graphite line, no chat-app rounded speech balloon. Header exact “衍月 C｜月牙便笺”, category “短句 · 阶段回应”. Name small “衍月”. Exact one-line dialogue “原来还能这样！” Friendly clear Chinese sans/gothic in medium weight with marginally lively baseline but fully aligned text, only punctuation subtly emphasized, no rainbow or comic shouting. Footer “字形设计”, specimen “衍月” and “这次，由我来。” then “姓名 20 px · 正文 24 px · 单行优先”. Lower gameplay inset shows tiny sliver near lower safe margin slightly LEFT, under puzzle scene; portrait on LEFT, no world HUD conflict, total height about 7% screen. Footer also has a SEPARATE unboxed subtitle sample labeled “无框字幕示例”, exact subtitle “衍月：星位亮了。” in white text with dark thin stroke shown over a small neutral navy swatch; no decorative UI border around subtitle. The tiny framed reaction should be used sparingly, and subtitle is default for short gameplay reactions. No arrow, no controls.

designs.title: 特斯拉 C｜校准批注
designs.prompt: Only Tesla, tiny clean face/neck portrait at RIGHT end of a very small clipped archival-note dialogue sliver, left-aligned text to LEFT of portrait. Short confirmation style, distinct from large story panel and medium communication. Ivory narrow paper tab with single brass bracket, ink-navy tiny coordinate cross, small stamped thin baseline, not a rounded messenger balloon, no huge seal. Header exact “特斯拉 C｜校准批注”, category “短句 · 关键确认”. Name small “特斯拉”. Exact one-line dialogue “位置正确，继续。” Calm technical Chinese sans/gothic medium-weight body, with sober small block-serif name. Footer “字形设计”, specimen “特斯拉” and “读数稳定，校准完成。” then “姓名 20 px · 正文 24 px · 单行优先”. Lower gameplay inset shows tiny note in lower blank margin slightly RIGHT, portrait on RIGHT, center rail and upper moon mechanism fully clear, total height about 7% screen. Footer also has SEPARATE unboxed subtitle sample labeled “无框字幕示例”, exact subtitle “特斯拉：现场校准完成。” in white text with a thin dark outline shown over small navy swatch, no decorative subtitle frame. This tiny frame is only for emphasis, default feedback uses subtitle. No arrow or interactive controls.
